compiled_state.title: E2E test: DEFER ruling creates orphan ticket; DROP ruling writes dropped_by_arbiter defense record
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: When arbiter emits a DEFER ruling, orchestrator creates an orphan-task ticket (ticket ID logged to cycle ledger entry) — end-to-end verified
- DD2: When arbiter emits a DROP ruling, defense record written with correct defense_type — end-to-end verified
- DD5: End-to-end test: simulate DEFER ruling → orphan ticket created with correct tags; simulate DROP ruling → defense record written with correct defense_type

## TDD Requirement
Write a new failing test file: tests/review/test-arbiter-ruling-dispatch.sh

Test function: test_defer_ruling_creates_orphan_ticket

Given: a simulated arbiter output JSON with one DEFER ruling (ruling="DEFER", finding_index=1, rationale="Finding deferred for future work", impact_class="maintainability")
When: the orchestrator post-arbiter processing logic is invoked via TICKET_CMD stub and DSO_SESSION_TICKET_ID set
Then:
  - A ticket create task call is made with title containing "Deferred review finding:"
  - The ticket create call includes tags orphan:deferred_review and origin:arbiter
  - Exit code is 0

Test function: test_drop_ruling_writes_defense_store_record

Given: a simulated arbiter output JSON with one DROP ruling (ruling="DROP", finding_index=2, rationale="Finding was based on incorrect premise")
When: the orchestrator post-arbiter processing logic invokes review-defense-store.sh via the TICKET_CMD stub
Then:
  - A DEFENSE_RECORD comment is written containing defense_type="dropped_by_arbiter"
  - The record includes prior_finding_id matching the finding_index
  - Exit code is 0

Test function: test_drop_ruling_idempotent

Given: the DROP ruling for finding_index=2 is processed twice (simulating CI retry)
When: defense_store_write is called twice with the same prior_finding_id and defense_type=dropped_by_arbiter
Then: only ONE DEFENSE_RECORD is written (idempotency confirmed)

## Implementation Notes
- Test file location: tests/review/test-arbiter-ruling-dispatch.sh
- This is an integration-style test: it exercises the defense store functions (sourced from review-defense-store.sh) and a mocked ticket CLI

### Test approach for DEFER ruling:
- Create a mock TICKET_CMD that captures "create" subcommand calls and records the args
- Simulate the orchestrator's DEFER ticket-creation logic by calling the same ticket create command the workflow would use
- Assert the mock received "create task" with the expected title and tags
- Note: the orchestrator logic lives in REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md (prose); for E2E testing purposes, extract the ticket-creation snippet into a testable bash function or test the snippet directly

### Test approach for DROP ruling:
- Create a mock TICKET_CMD that records comment calls and returns a ticket JSON
- Source review-defense-store.sh and call defense_store_write() with a record containing defense_type=dropped_by_arbiter
- Assert the DEFENSE_RECORD: prefix appears in the captured mock output
- Assert the JSON contains "dropped_by_arbiter"

### Test approach for idempotency:
- Call defense_store_write() twice with the same prior_finding_id + defense_type=dropped_by_arbiter
- Mock TICKET_CMD needs to return the existing record on the second show call to trigger the dedup check
- Assert the ticket comment count is 1 (mock call count check)

### Fuzzy-match note:
- Source: review-defense-store.sh → normalized: reviewdefensestoresh
- Test: test-arbiter-ruling-dispatch.sh → normalized: testarbiterrulingdispatchsh
- No substring match. Requires .test-index entry mapping review-defense-store.sh to test-arbiter-ruling-dispatch.sh

## File Impact
- tests/review/test-arbiter-ruling-dispatch.sh: create (new test file)
- .test-index: add entry for test-arbiter-ruling-dispatch.sh

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Test file tests/review/test-arbiter-ruling-dispatch.sh exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/review/test-arbiter-ruling-dispatch.sh
- [ ] Three test functions present in the file
  Verify: grep -c "^test_" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/review/test-arbiter-ruling-dispatch.sh | awk '{exit ($1 < 3)}'
- [ ] Tests FAIL before implementations complete (RED signal when Tasks 2 and 4 not yet done)
  Verify: (RED signal confirmed during task ordering — orchestrator verifies test fails before dispatching impl tasks)
- [ ] Tests PASS after Tasks 2 and 4 are complete
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/review/test-arbiter-ruling-dispatch.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE "FAILED: 0\b"
- [ ] DEFER ruling test confirms ticket create call with title "Deferred review finding:" and tags orphan:deferred_review
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/review/test-arbiter-ruling-dispatch.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE "FAILED: 0\b"
- [ ] DROP ruling test confirms DEFENSE_RECORD contains defense_type=dropped_by_arbiter
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/review/test-arbiter-ruling-dispatch.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE "FAILED: 0\b"
- [ ] Idempotency test confirms only one DEFENSE_RECORD written for repeated DROP ruling
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/review/test-arbiter-ruling-dispatch.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE "FAILED: 0\b"
- [ ] .test-index entry maps review-defense-store.sh to test-arbiter-ruling-dispatch.sh
  Verify: grep -q "test-arbiter-ruling-dispatch.sh" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index
- [ ] RED marker [test_defer_ruling_creates_orphan_ticket] added to .test-index
  Verify: grep "\[test_defer_ruling_creates_orphan_ticket\]" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
